statement.essentials: Surgeons find the nerve trunk a few millimetres below a seam in the bone below the ear canal.
statement.anatomy: The tympanomastoid suture is a bony landmark for the trunk: in cadavers and live patients the closest distance was about 2 mm, and one protocol places the nerve approximately 2 mm inferior to the suture. Reported distances vary with the reference point used.

numbers.label: Suture to trunk (cadaver)
numbers.population: 14 cadavers (22 live patients gave a mean of 2.0 mm, range 0 to 4)
